subject: ইংরেজি
question: Neither of the operators _____ present yesterday.
explanation: Neither of + plural noun-এর পর verb সর্বদা singular হয়।

subject: ইংরেজি
question: The data entry operator _____ the report before the officer arrived.
explanation: Past Perfect টেন্সে Before-এর পূর্ববর্তী ক্লজ had + V3 হয়।

subject: ইংরেজি
question: It is high time we _____ the digital database.
explanation: It is high time / It is time-এর পর past indefinite tense হয়।
